policies.description: Requires modifier -59 for distinct procedural services on same day
policies.fix: Add modifier -59 to indicate this is a distinct procedural service separate from other procedures performed the same day

policies.description: Physical therapy CPT codes require prior authorization for more than 6 visits
policies.fix: Obtain prior authorization from BlueCross before submitting claims beyond 6 physical therapy visits

policies.description: Telehealth visits require place of service code 02 and modifier -95
policies.fix: Add modifier -95 and place of service 02 for all telehealth visits billed to BlueCross

policies.description: Aetna requires pre-authorization for all MRI procedures
policies.fix: Obtain Aetna prior authorization before performing MRI. Call 1-800-Aetna-1 or use Aetna portal

policies.description: Aetna does not cover acupuncture under standard plans
policies.fix: Verify patient has supplemental acupuncture benefit. If not covered bill patient directly

policies.description: Medicare does not cover routine physicals under standard Part B
policies.fix: Bill Welcome to Medicare visit (G0402) for first year beneficiaries or Annual Wellness Visit (G0438/G0439) for subsequent years

policies.description: Medicare requires -GA modifier when patient has signed ABN for non-covered service
policies.fix: Attach signed ABN form and add modifier -GA to the claim to bill patient for non-covered service

policies.description: United requires prior authorization for sleep studies
policies.fix: Submit prior authorization request through United portal before scheduling sleep study

policies.description: United requires modifier -25 AND documentation of medical necessity for same-day E/M and procedure
policies.fix: Add modifier -25 to E/M code and ensure documentation clearly states the E/M was a separate and distinct service from the procedure
